verdict.rationale: Ramp provides a documented official CLI (ramp-cli) and a full REST/OpenAPI developer API plus machine-readable docs (llms.txt, llms-api.txt, openapi/developer-api.json), which together enable scripted/headless automation suitable for CI pipelines. However, there is no first-party or community evidence of actual CI usage, rate-limit guidance for automated pipelines, or examples of running the CLI unattended. Missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration examples, independent confirmation of headless CLI use in production pipelines, and details on authentication/rate limits for automated batch jobs.
